title_as_printed: Heat Capacity of Aqueous Sodium Sulfate
pressure_note: Flow calorimeter; each block prints two pressures. P taken as the pressure printed in the phiCp/density/cps column headings (1.01, 3.69, 9.40, 16.04, 200 bar; the text says the data along the saturation curve were analysed assuming the density ratio is constant from 1 to 16 bar). The ratio column prints a different measured pressure (1.01, 5, 10, 17, 207.2, 199.2 bar). Text: measurements at 1 bar or the saturated vapor pressure, and at 200 bar.

value.what: apparent molal heat capacity of Na2SO4, calculated by the authors from the measured heat-capacity ratio

value2.what: measured heat-capacity ratio solution/water corrected by density ratio at 25 C (raw calorimeter quantity)

value3.what: specific heat capacity of solution, derived from ratio with water cp from literature

extra_unmapped: rhos(25 C), g/cm3 (literature or estimated solution density at 25 C used in the analysis, not measured here)
conversion_needs: molality assumed mol per kg water (not explicitly stated)
notes: Rows with molality 0 are pure-water reference rows (phiCp empty). Rows at 2.6294 m in the 200 bar blocks have only the ratio printed. The 474.68 K block ends at 0.2491 m on the printed page (page 2890 bottom, continues no further on 2891) - the block appears truncated in the print. Blocks stacked in printed order.
